title: Account Manager - Sovereign Cloud & AI Services
description:
**Introducing evroc**
 At evroc, we are building a secure, sovereign, and sustainable hyperscale cloud to reimagine the digital future of Europe. By joining our company, you have an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation cloud services. We are seeking intellectually curious and highly motivated team members who are ready to embrace the thrilling challenge of building the first European-owned hyperscale cloud.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Job type:** 
 Permanent position
   

  

**Join the Pioneers**
 We’re looking for an Account Manager to help accelerate the adoption of evroc’s Sovereign Cloud and AI services across the Nordic region. In this role, you’ll own the full customer journey, from identifying new opportunities and building executive relationships to expanding existing accounts and supporting long-term cloud transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Working closely with Solutions Architects, Product, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance teams, you’ll help organisations navigate complex cloud and AI decisions where security, sovereignty, and compliance are business-critical. This is an opportunity to work with some of the region’s most important organisations while helping shape Europe’s digital future.
   

  

**What You’ll Tackle**
* Own the full sales cycle for evroc’s Sovereign Cloud and AI services, from prospecting through contract execution.
* Develop territory and account plans, build a qualified pipeline, and deliver against ambitious revenue targets.
* Build trusted relationships with C-level executives and senior decision-makers across the public and private sectors.
* Help customers understand how sovereign cloud and AI services can address their security, compliance, and business transformation requirements.
* Lead strategic account planning, executive business reviews, and long-term customer development.
* Collaborate with Solutions Architects, Product, Engineering, and Legal teams to develop competitive customer proposals.
* Work closely with strategic technology partners to identify and accelerate new business opportunities.
* Maintain accurate forecasts and strong CRM discipline across all customer engagements.


**Skills We Value**
* A proven track record in enterprise B2B sales, with consistent quota attainment.
* A hunter mentality, you are not afraid to pursue greenfield opportunities and think creatively about how to acquire new customers.

**Why Join evroc?**
 We offer a competitive salary and an equity package to attract the best. Whether it’s the cosmopolitan allure of London, vibrant Stockholm, or the Mediterranean charm of Sophia Antipolis, you’re poised for an inspiring work environment and a captivating local culture!
   

  

 At evroc, diversity is our strength. We champion an inclusive environment where every background, ethnicity, age, gender identity, beliefs, and culture, is celebrated.
   

  

 Applicants must possess a valid work permit.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Survey & Design
description:
*10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.* 




*With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.* 




*Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.* 




  





***About the role***




 As a Full-Stack Engineer in our Survey & Design team, you'll help build the products that support some of the most important steps in Aira's customer acquisition journey.
 



  





 The team is responsible for the tools used to capture and manage information about our customers' homes, supporting everything from home surveys and technical assessments to installation design. These products help ensure that the right information is available throughout the process, enabling tailored and efficient clean energy solutions.
 



  





 You'll join a small, autonomous product team and work closely with product managers, designers and engineers to solve real-world challenges and build scalable solutions that support Aira's continued growth across Europe.
 



 As a Full-Stack Engineer, you'll play a key role in shaping the products and services that power these workflows. You'll work across the stack to build scalable solutions and great user experiences.
 



  





***In this role, you will***



* Design and build applications and services that support users across multiple European markets
* Develop scalable APIs and integrations with third-party systems
* Process and manage data collected throughout the Survey & Design journey
* Transform complex technical and geometric data into solutions that support our products and workflows
* Contribute to architectural decisions and the long-term evolution of the platform
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers and end users to improve workflows, user experiences and product capabilities
* Explore new technologies and approaches that help solve real business problems



  





 We're making home energy design smarter, simpler and more scalable. If you enjoy building great products and solving complex problems in a technically challenging domain, this role is for you.
 



  





***What you'll bring to the team***



* Around 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
* Experience building modern software applications across different parts of the stack
* Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot
* Experience designing and building APIs
* A solid understanding of databases, software architecture and distributed systems
* Experience working with microservices
* The ability to turn ideas into clean, testable and scalable software
* A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership
* Strong collaboration and communication skills



  





 We believe you'll thrive in this role if you're curious, analytical and enjoy understanding the real-world challenges behind the software you build. You don't need a background in engineering, but an interest in technical domains and complex problem-solving will help you succeed.
 



 We're also looking for someone who enjoys learning new technologies and is curious about how emerging technologies, including AI, can create value for both products and ways of working.
 



  





*Our tech stack:* 




 Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka, gRPC, Kotlin, Python, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Kubernetes and Docker.
 



  





***What is in it for you?***



* Join a mission-driven company accelerating the transition to clean energy across Europe
* Work on products that have a direct impact on how clean energy solutions are designed and delivered
* Be part of a small, highly autonomous team with significant influence on product and technical decisions
* Collaborate with talented colleagues across product, engineering and operations
* Grow professionally in a fast-moving and international environment
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.



  





 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: Systemintegratör
description:
Vi söker nu fler systemintegratörer till vårt team som arbetar med att integrera och driftsätta Tutus lösningar kring säker kommunikation och informationshantering. IT säkerhet går som en röd tråd i allt vi gör och våra projekt är oftast nätverks/Linux orienterade.
   

  

 I denna roll ingår också i viss utsträckning arbetsuppgifter som är ganska traditionella för en nätverkstekniker. Hos oss får du arbeta med produkter som är avgörande för bl.a Sveriges försvar, polis, och liknande organisationer. I rollen ingår interaktion med kunder. I gruppen och bolaget finns en bred och lång erfarenhet och vår vänskapliga teamanda gör att vi alla delar och lär av varandra.
   

  

**Din bakgrund**
 Denna roll är ganska bred och du får goda möjligheter att lära och utvecklas. För att kunna göra ett bra arbete bör du ha med dig ca 3-6 års erfarenhet från liknande arbetsuppgifter, t.ex. sätta upp system och felsökning.
   

  

 Din erfarenhet kan dock komma från såväl den civila/privata sidan som från t.ex. försvar eller polis. En kombination av god IT teknisk förståelse och ett högt säkerhetstänk tillsammans med ett intresse för att samarbeta med andra inom Tutus och också med våra kunder är viktigt för att kunna lyckas och trivas.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har**
* Utbildning i relevant område eller motsvarande erfarenhet skaffad på annat sätt
* Goda erfarenheter av Linux och nätverk (routing, switch, TCP/IP)
* Starkt IT-säkerhetstänk och intresse för, gärna erfarenhet av, säkerhet på hög nivå
* Arbete i en kundorienterad miljö


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av/kunskap inom**
* Serverhårdvara, Brandväggar och VPN
* Kryptering/PKI
* Mobiltelefoni/Android
* Arbete i en miljö med högt ställda krav på IT säkerhet


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Vi är ett office-first bolag där samarbete och korta beslutsvägar är en del av vår vardag. Samtidigt finns vissa möjligheter till att jobba remote när rollen och uppdraget tillåter det.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss är placerad i säkerhetsklass och säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer därför att genomföras vid anställning i enlighet med 3 kap. säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).

title: Agentic Automation Architect
description:
Do you thrive on shaping scalable automation solutions and guiding others to make the right technical decisions in complex environments? Then this is your chance to shape the future of automation and empower teams to build smarter, scalable solutions.
   

  

**Why Sandvik Coromant?**
 Step into a collaborative and forward-thinking environment where automation is at the heart of how we improve business processes and enable innovation. Joining us, you also get to:
   

  

* Work in an advanced data and AI team spanning multiple locations
* Take on a key advisory role influencing technical direction and best practices
* Join a team where knowledge sharing and enablement are central to success


**About The Job**
 As Agentic Automation Architect, you’re the authority on design and build decisions for automation and agentic solutions. Acting as a trusted advisor for technical questions you guide engineers, collaborate with stakeholders, and ensure scalable, high-quality, and compliant automation across the organization.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Define architecture for automation and agentic platforms, including tools and offerings
* Design and build automated solutions by translating business needs into technical implementations
* Lead technical direction through standards, best practices, and coaching
* Enable self-service and AI fluency by sharing technical guidance, reusable patterns, and help teams and champion communities adopt automation and agentic AI responsibly
* Design, develop, test, and implement solutions that improve efficiency and streamline processes


**Location and flexibility**
 This position is based in Solna or Sandviken and offers a hybrid work setup with the flexibility to work remotely part of the time.
   

  

**Your profile**
 You bring expertise in automation engineering and a clear ability to connect business needs with scalable technical solutions. With a strategic mindset and experience from complex environments, you know how to guide teams and shape architectures that last.
   

  

 Your background includes:
   

  

* Degree in Computer Science or similar field
* Experience in automation engineering and agentic automation
* Strong skills in UiPath, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and at least one programming laguageExperience leading technical work in agile environments
* Ability to translate business needs into automation solutions and coach others


 You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to drive automation at scale. Working independently, you guide and coach others while influencing without formal authority. You communicate complex concepts clearly, translate business needs into technical solutions, and stay curious, always focused on enabling team success.
   

  

**Our culture**
 Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.

 We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.
   

  

 Union contacts (Sweden):
   

  

* Thomas Lilja, Unionen, +46 (0)70-261 04 82
* Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87
* Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70-222 48 55


 Hiring Manager: Robin Wessman
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Send your application no later than September 2, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0093387.
   

  

 We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.
   

  

 To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com

title: Integrationskonsult
description:
**Om Xledger** 




*Xledger är en norsk privatägd koncern som startades 2000 med målet att utveckla ett marknads-ledande komplett affärssystem på en SaaS plattform. Idag är Xledger det mest kompletta molnbaserade affärssystemet på marknaden och har under de senaste åren etablerat sig som den ledande webbaserade ERP-leverantören för mellanstora och stora verksamheter. Med en helhetslösning förenklar vi vardagen för 11 000 företag i över 60 länder genom att automatisera ekonomiprocesser. Xledger Group har 300 anställda och dotterbolag som säljer och levererar tjänsten i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Storbritannien och USA.* 




 Vill du arbeta med integrationer i en modern affärssystemmiljö?
 



  





 Vi söker nu en
 **Integrationskonsult** 
 till vårt team!
 



 Hos Xledger blir du del av ett innovativt och växande företag där engagemang, samarbete och kundfokus står i centrum. Du får arbeta med ett molnbaserat affärssystem i framkant och hjälpa våra kunder att skapa effektiva, hållbara integrationer mellan Xledger och andra verksamhetssystem – tillsammans med kollegor som brinner för teknik, innovation och kundnytta
 **.** 




  





**Om rollen som Integrationskonsult** 




 Som integrationskonsult hos Xledger har du en nyckelroll i att säkerställa smidiga och tillförlitliga integrationer mellan vårt ERP-system och kundernas övriga systemlandskap, exempelvis lönesystem, inköpssystem, CRM, projektsystem, BI-lösningar och andra verksamhetskritiska applikationer. Du arbetar nära våra kunder, projektledare, konsulter och lösningsarkitekter för att analysera kundens systemmiljö och integrationsbehov, designa, implementera och konfigurera integrationer samt säkerställa korrekt dataflöde, kvalitet och prestanda. Du bidrar också till att skapa effektiva och automatiserade affärsprocesser. Rollen passar dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan teknik och verksamhet och som tycker om att förstå hur olika system samverkar för att skapa affärsnytta. Du kommer att ingå i ett team med erfarna projektledare, konsulter och lösningsarkitekter där ni arbetar tätt tillsammans för att leverera stabila och framtidssäkra integrationslösningar. Du rapporterar direkt till konsultchefen och blir en viktig del av vårt härliga team.
 



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Du trivs i en konsultativ roll där du kombinerar teknisk förståelse med kunddialog och problemlösning. Vi tror att du har:
 



 · Erfarenhet av integrationer mellan affärssystem och andra verksamhetssystem
 



 · Förståelse för ERP-system och hur data används i olika affärsprocesser
 



 · Analytisk förmåga och ett strukturerat arbetssätt
 



 · Intresse för digitalisering, automation och informationsflöden
 



 · God kommunikativ förmåga och trivs med kundkontakt och samarbete
 



 · Ett lösningsorienterat, nyfiket och serviceinriktat mindset
 



 · Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för dina leveranser.
 



  





**Vad kan vi erbjuda?** 




 Du erbjuds en arbetsplats i stark tillväxt med korta beslutsvägar och ett högt engagemang, där du får möjlighet att arbeta med moderna integrationslösningar i ett ledande molnbaserat ERP-system. I rollen ges du stort utrymme att påverka kundernas systemarkitektur och arbetssätt, samtidigt som du utvecklas både professionellt och personligt i takt med bolagets expansion. Arbetet är varierat och omfattar såväl större implementationsprojekt som mindre integrationsuppdrag, och du blir en del av en öppen och inspirerande arbetsmiljö med stark kunskapsdelning och samarbete. Dessutom får du ett givande utbyte med kollegor inom Xledger Group och arbetar främst från det fina kontoret i Solna, med inslag av kundbesök.

title: M365 User Adoption Specialist
description:
Välj Telge – här får du kombinera affärsmässighet med samhällsnytta och som medarbetare får du frihet under ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.
   

  

 Så här säger Per Berglund, rekryterande chef om rollen:
   

  

 ”Hos oss får du en central roll i att få ut verklig effekt av Microsoft 365. Det handlar inte om teknik i sig, utan om att hjälpa våra medarbetare att jobba smartare, tillsammans. Du blir en viktig del i att utveckla vår digitala arbetsplats och skapa nytta på riktigt."
   

  

 Uppdrag och kompetenskrav
   

  

 Som M365 User Adoption Specialist arbetar du nära verksamheten med att säkerställa att vi får ut maximal nytta av vår M365-plattform. Du är en nyckelperson i arbetet med att skapa nytta, där fokus ligger på att utveckla arbetssätt, öka användning och stötta medarbetare i det dagliga arbetet.
   

  

 I rollen driver du införande och användning (user adoption) och nyttorealisering inom M365 genom att planera och genomföra workshops, utbildningar och teamövningar. Du stöttar verksamheten i hur de använder verktyg som Teams, SharePoint och Copilot på bästa sätt och fungerar som en rådgivande part kring moderna arbetssätt och samarbete. Du ansvarar även för att driva och utveckla forum kopplade till M365 och Copilot, följa upp användning samt bidra till kontinuerlig utveckling. En viktig del av rollen är att hålla dig uppdaterad kring nya funktioner och möjligheter i plattformen, samt att fungera som en brygga mellan IT och verksamheten. Du arbetar nära flera funktioner såsom verksamhet, ledningsgrupper, ambassadörer, HR, kommunikation, supportorganisation samt IT och externa leverantörer.
   

  

 För att passa i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med M365 (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Copilot)
* Erfarenhet av user adoption, förändringsledning eller införande av digitala arbetssätt
* Erfarenhet av att hålla workshops, utbildningar eller liknande aktiviteter
* Erfarenhet av verksamhetsnära arbete och förmåga att omsätta behov till konkreta arbetssätt och rekommendationer
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att anpassa budskap till olika målgrupper, från ledning till slutanvändare
* Grundläggande förståelse för informationssäkerhet, GDPR och säkert användande av digitala verktyg


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från offentlig sektor eller större organisationer, där du har arbetat i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter. Har du arbetat strukturerat med förändringsledning, exempelvis enligt Prosci eller liknande metodik, ser vi det som ett plus.
   

  

 Vi ser också gärna att du har kommit i kontakt med etablerade arbetssätt och metoder kopplade till digital utveckling, till exempel erfarenhet av att arbeta med utbildningsportaler eller e-learning (som Learnifier eller motsvarande), eller att du har använt projektmetodik såsom XLPM eller liknande ramverk i ditt arbete.
   

  

 Vidare är det positivt om du har en generell förståelse för närliggande områden inom M365-ekosystemet, såsom Power Platform, Copilot, automatisering eller AI-relaterade arbetssätt – inte för att utveckla lösningar själv, utan för att kunna förstå möjligheter och föra dialog med verksamheten.
   

  

 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är pedagogisk och kommunikativ med god förmåga att anpassa budskap till olika målgrupper. Du är relationsskapande och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor, samtidigt som du är drivande och tar initiativ för att få saker att hända. Vidare är du nyfiken och håller dig uppdaterad inom området samt har ett serviceinriktat förhållningssätt där du motiveras av att stötta andra och skapa värde i verksamheten.
   

  

 Telgekoncernen och Södertälje kommun har en omfattande IT-miljö med ca 8 000 användare. Detta ställer stora krav på oss som organisation och är en viktig del av vår digitalisering. Du samarbetar med kollegor från alla hörn av vår stora organisation.
   

  

 Välj Telge
   

  

 Inom Telge finns alla möjligheter för dig att själv forma din framtid. Här finns det plats att växa, både i din yrkesroll och som människa. Telge är en arbetsplats med trygga anställningsvillkor. Du som anställd hos oss omfattas av kollektivavtal där viktiga saker som försäkringar och pension ingår.
   

  

 Här får du mindre pussel och mer liv. Att ha balans mellan arbetslivet och den privata sfären är viktig för ett hållbart liv. Så långt det är möjligt har vi flexibla arbetstider där var och en styr över sin tid. Vi erbjuder flera förmåner som gör vardagen lite lättare – som 3 000 kronor i friskvårdsbidrag per år, föräldrapenningtillägg och utökad sjuklön. Hos oss får du trygghet, balans och möjligheten att må bra – både på och utanför jobbet.
   

  

 Läs mer om några av våra medarbetare som valt Telge: Vi valde Telge
   

  

 Mångfald inkludering och trygghet
   

  

 Vi på Telge arbetar aktivt för mångfald och inkludering och välkomnar därför medarbetare med olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och kompetenser. En trygg och säker arbetsmiljö är vår högsta prioritet. Arbetspsykologiska tester ingår i våra rekryteringsprocesser till chefs- och specialisttjänster och vi genomför återkommande, slumpmässiga drogtester bland alla våra medarbetare.
   

  

 Sista ansökningsdatum
   

  

 31 Augusti 2026
   

  

 Några frågor?
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om tjänsten eller har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen? I den här rekryteringen samarbetar vi med Experis IT. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Pia Boström på 0703-14 68 66 eller pia.bostrom@se.experis.com. Fackliga kontakter är vision@telge.se för Vision, Magnus Enderin för SACO, Jessica Borgen för Kommunal. Dessa nås på 08-550 220 00.
   

  

 Är du nyfiken på att läsa mer om oss?

title: Engineering Manager
description:
You know that bit where every company says they’re
 *“changing the world”* 
 ? Yeah, it can feel a little forced. But we like to think our story actually has some realness to it.
 



  





 Our story begins with Shadi Bitar and Ninos Malki, who came to Sweden from Syria as kids and discovered that books could be a bridge – helping them learn the language, understand the culture, and explore new worlds.
 



  





 A thought emerged,
 *what if everyone could have that?* 
 And just like that, Nextory was born – your all-access pass to read, listen, and discover new perspectives without limits.
 



  





 And now, we’re searching for an
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who’s ready to lead the way. Turning ideas into experiences that inspire people to start their reading journey with us.
 



  





**Let us tell you about the role 📚** 




 As an Engineering Manager at Nextory, you’ll lead our Join Team, a talented group shaping the web experience at the very beginning of the customer journey with us. You’ll play a key role in inspiring potential readers to take their first step into the world of Nextory, combining technical leadership with people development to create seamless, engaging and high-performing digital experiences.
 



  





 Your work will include:
 


* Managing and empowering a team of six engineers to grow, collaborate, and deliver impact.
* Ensuring technical excellence and delivery quality in close collaboration with product and design.
* Driving transparency, collaboration, and innovation across teams.



  





**The main character we’re looking for 👀** 




 You have a solid background as a software engineer and several years of experience leading developers in a fast-moving digital environment. You take pride in building teams that consistently deliver results, and have fun doing it. We believe you thrive on creating an environment where people grow, perform at their best and turn great ideas into measurable results.
 



  





 We believe you:
 


* Bring experience from full-stack environments, with a true passion for frontend development.
* Feel confident working with JavaScript and TypeScript with a Java backend.
* Understand how to build high-performing web applications, CI/CD pipelines and smart SEO practices
* Have a track record of improving customer onboarding journeys and turning insights into great user experiences.



  





**The Nextory way of working 🏠** 




 At Nextory, we believe a strong and inclusive culture is key to our success – and that culture flourishes when we meet and collaborate in person as much as possible. That’s why we spend the majority of the working time at our beautiful office!
 



  





 We are based in Stockholm, Sweden, with offices in Paris and Bangalore. Our hybrid work policy includes four days in the office and Wednesdays as a work-from-home day.
 



  





**Your next story starts here** 




 We look forward to your application 💫. Applications are reviewed continuously and if you have any questions about the role, please contact erika.thorslund@nextory.com
 



*Please note that we do not offer relocation and that a six-month probationary period applies.*

title: Senior Presales Consultant
description:
**AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably.**

**We’re the first software business in the world to have our sustainability targets validated by the SBTi, and we’ve been recognized for the transparency and ambition of our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We’ve also recently been named as one of the world’s most innovative companies.**

**If you’re a curious and collaborative person who wants to make a big impact through technology, then we want to hear from you! Find out more at** **AVEVA Careers****.**

**For more information about our privacy policy and how to manage cookies, visit our** **Privacy Policy****.**

**Job Title:** Senior Solution Consultant

**Location:** Sweden / Norway / Denmark - Hybrid

**Employment Type:** Full Time

 **The job**

*This is a presales role, with responsibility for supporting sales opportunities with new prospects and existing customers. Focused on the areas of real time operational data management from the edge to enterprise including data collection, transformation, contextualization and visualization and the use of advanced analytics and AI/ML models on this operational data to provide insights and optimization. The job is primarily customer facing and requires a desired balance of professional presales skills, technology application to solve client requirements, and industry knowledge of our markets.*

*The Senior Presales Consultant must be able to identify and articulate the customer’s key business requirements and develop these into a compelling solution offering. They will then be able to clearly, concisely and professionally present, demonstrate and prove the solution and the value they bring to the customer.*

*The Senior Presales Consultant is an integral and highly visible member of the Northern European Presales team. They will be a key contributor to the growth of the business within the region, providing outstanding consultancy and pre-sales support. Primarily working with the regional sales teams, the position also requires close interaction with product management, product development and marketing, as well as customer support and services. This position reports directly to the Presales Manager for Northern Europe.*

 **Key responsibilities**

* *Become trusted partner for customers focusing on Edge to Enterprise solutions including AVEVA PI System, AVEVA Flows, AVEVA Connect and AVEVA Advanced Analytics*
* *Define the customer-specific Solution based requirements and alignment with AVEVA solutions*
* *Present the solution using a blend of presentation and live demonstration*
* *Lead pre-sales activities relating to preliminary solution architecture definition*
* *Support definition workshops involving cross-functional teams to define the solution architecture and system level interfaces and data flows*
* *Contribute to technical proposals*
* *Support proof of concepts and/or pilots*
* *Educate customers and partners on new products & best practices*
* *Be a critical input channel to product management and marketing on any aspect of the products, marketplace, and most importantly, the customer perspective*
 **Essential requirements**

* *Several years in an industrial software / data analytics space.*
* *Strong experience in Consulting,* *Technical Sales, Technical Support or Solution Delivery with proven experience in defining and developing industrial operational data systems.*
* *An understanding of AI/ML models and techniques in the context of industrial applications.*
* *Industry knowledge (based on industries covered) and thorough working knowledge of products and solutions within operations data management, operational optimization and industrial data analytics.*
* *Understands the positioning of the AVEVA solutions portfolio and can use this knowledge to design the most appropriate architecture and technology, guiding the customer to AVEVA’s solutions is a plus*
* *Aptitude for problem solving, innovative thinking in a sustainable way. Strong problem solving aptitude and ready to accept new challenges to manage internal and external customer expectations*
 **Desired skills**

* *AVEVA Products Certifications*
* *Microsoft Certifications*
* *SaaS / Cyber Security Certifications*
* *AI / ML / Data Analytics certifications*
 **Commercial** **at AVEVA**


Our Commercial team, comprised of over 2,000 dedicated colleagues, is the backbone of our customer relationships and business growth. From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions.

  

If you're passionate about driving growth, tackling complex business challenges, and fostering strong customer relationships, you'll find success and fulfilment in our Commercial team.

  

Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

**AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**

 **AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**  

  

**Come and join AVEVA to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

title: Build Engineer
description:
### **Description**

  

At TTK Games we are fuelled by a passion to inspire, connect, and entertain.### **We're seeking an individual who can help us continue to break boundaries, lead by example, and deliver on our promise to players.**

  

As a Build Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the development pipeline. Your primary responsibility will be to develop, maintain, and enhance the tools and systems used by the development team to build, test, and deploy game software.### **What you will do**

  

* Develop and maintain automated build systems to compile source code, package game assets, and generate builds for multiple platforms (e.g., PC, consoles).
* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment processes, enabling rapid iteration and delivery of game builds.
* Oversee version control systems (e.g., Git, Perforce) to track changes, ensure code integrity, and facilitate collaboration among team members.
* Identify and address performance bottlenecks in the build process, optimizing workflows to enhance productivity and reduce build times.
* Provide assistance and troubleshooting for developers using build tools and systems, ensuring smooth operation and minimizing disruptions to the development process.
  

  

### **Who you are**

  

* 3+ years of experience in game development.
* Experience developing build tools and pipelines supporting a shipped game title.
* Experience working with build systems (Jenkins, Horde etc.).
* Programming/scripting knowledge (C++, C#, Python).
* Experience working with Source Control (Git, Perforce).

  


*Salary range Starting from SEK 35,000 rising to SEK 75,000 with experience, plus bi-annual bonus, and perks.*### **About TTK Games AB**


At TTK Games we are fuelled by a passion to inspire, connect, and entertain.  

  

We're seeking an individual who can help us continue to break boundaries, to lead by example, and deliver on our promise to players.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
The Role
  
As a Electrical Engineer at Nordic Air Defence, you will be responsible for the design and development of low-latency analog sensor systems. You will interface with our other engineers across embedded software engineering, mechanical design, aerospace engineering to build customer-ready additions to our K100 flight vehicle.
  
Responsibilities
  
Design and implement high-speed analog amplifiers and filters.
  
Develop and test new analog sensing technology for the “seeker” of the K100 flight vehicle.
  
Work together with our supply-chain team to have your designs manufactured, shipped, tested.
  
Validate and prove the efficacy of your designs in simulation environments and on the lab bench.
  
Participate in real-world flight demonstrations of your work.
  
Overall system design to ensure good EMI performance.
  
  

Requirements (Required)
  
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, or related field. A PhD is considered a plus.
  
3+ years experience with optoelectronics, RF, RADAR, or LiDAR.
  
Familiarity with using simulation tools (i.e. AWR Microwave Office, LTSpice).
  
Proven experience the design and building of sophisticated analog circuitry.
  
Strong understanding of signal processing both in the analog and digital domains.
  
Experience designing and manufacturing PCBs using Altium, Eagle, KiCAD or similar.
  
Knowledge and experience in designing for environmental constraints (temperature, humidity, and vibration).
  
Ownership of your work from start to finish.
  
Fluency in English, both written and oral.
  
Exceptional organization and communication skills (both written and oral).
  
  

Requirements (Nice-to-have)
  
Experience in autonomous systems or drones.
  
Experience from the defence or aerospace industry.
  
Familiarity liaising with mechanical design teams to fit your circuit designs in a variety of physical spaces.
  
Experience working in a startup environment.
  
Experience building products using a NATO supply chain.
  
Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, or C++ for algorithm development.
  
Antenna design experience.

title: Experienced Firmware Engineer – Fixed Dome Cameras
description:
**Job Title**
-------------


Experienced Firmware Engineer – Fixed Dome Cameras**Job Description**
-------------------

*Are you a curious engineer who loves digging into complex systems and finding smart solutions? We're looking for an Experienced Firmware Engineer to join the Fixed Dome Firmware team at our HQ in Lund, Sweden. Here, you'll work with creating a smarter, safer world and help bring the next generation of network video products to life.*

**Who is your future team?**


You will be an important part of our Fixed Dome Firmware team, where you will develop, deliver, and maintain the software for a large range of Axis core products. We are a dedicated team of developers with diverse experience and knowledge, working together in an agile and open climate. As a firmware engineer, you take ownership of the projects you work on and share responsibility for ensuring all projects in our department move forward and meet their targets. We succeed at this by working as a team.

**What you'll do here as an Experienced Firmware Engineer**


As a firmware engineer in our team, you play a key role in bringing the next generation of Axis products to life — your work directly powers the devices that help create a smarter, safer world.

* Join product development projects, developing network-connected devices
* Configure and adapt AXIS OS, our own Linux-based operating system, for our next generation of products

* Contribute to continuously improving the way we work as a team
* Collaborate closely with your colleagues, sharing knowledge and offering support

**Who are we looking for?**


We are looking for a collaborative and curious team player who thrives on challenges and loves to learn. You are comfortable working in a changing environment and have a genuine passion for technology. You enjoy solving problems together with your colleagues, which means strong communication skills are important.


You bring a personal drive and are energised by working in an environment of openness, creativity, trust, and commitment. As Axis values teamwork, it is important that you contribute with a positive spirit and are comfortable working with agile methodologies.

**We'd love to hear that you have/are:**

* 5+ years of experience in firmware or embedded software development
* Solid knowledge of Linux system programming — user space, kernel space, and device drivers
* Experience with C and/or C++ programming
* Familiarity with continuous integration, version control using Git, and build tools
* Experience working with agile methodologies
* An engineering bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, physics, mathematics, electrical engineering, or equivalent experience
* Familiar working with AI-powered development tools

**Bonus points if you also bring:**

* Experience with debug tools such as GDB and Valgrind
* Familiarity with scripting languages — shell, Python, or Perl
* Working knowledge of low-level programming, e.g., using Micro Controllers (MCU)
* Experience leading agile teams

**What Axis have to offer**


We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security — developing solutions used worldwide.


As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.


Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration — whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities.


Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.

**Curious to discover more?**

* Life at Axis blog
* Engineering at Axis blog
* Innovation at Axis

**Ready to Act?**


Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity — something that is fundamental to our success. We welcome all applications. If you need any adjustments to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know.


We review applications continuously, so don't wait — send in your application today!

We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. title: Functional Safety Engineer
description:
Join Us in Transforming the Future!  



It all starts with people. People like you.  


**About Us**  



At Epiroc, innovation and collaboration are at the core of everything we do. Our vision is clear: to accelerate the transformation of mining towards a greener, safer and more sustainable industry. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of system development, contributing to safe and compliant solutions that support the next generation of automation and control systems.  


**Your Mission**  



As a Functional Safety Engineer, you play a key role in developing and supporting safety-related functions across our systems. You ensure compliance with applicable standards and legal requirements, contributing to robust, reliable, and high-quality solutions.  



You lead and support risk assessments, develop safety concepts, and drive verification and validation activities. In addition, you are responsible for documenting functional safety processes and act as a specialist supporting cross-functional teams within the product line. You actively contribute to competence development, consistency, and continuous improvement within safety-related development. The role may also take a leading part in our work to fulfil upcoming regulatory requirements, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and the Data Act, ensuring that our products and development practices align with new compliance expectations.  



In this role, you collaborate closely across disciplines, influencing technical solutions and ensuring that safety is integrated throughout the product lifecycle.  


**Your Profile**  



You are a structured and quality-driven professional with strong ownership and a proactive approach to risk management. You collaborate effectively, communicate clearly, and influence safety-related decisions with confidence.  



To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of analytical thinking, system understanding, and passion for safety-critical development. You thrive in cross-functional environments and continuously seek to improve both solutions and ways of working.  



Other requirements:
* Strong competence in functional safety, including risk assessment, safety concept development, and application of standards such as ISO 12100 and ISO 13849
* Experiene from CRA and Data Act is meriting
* Broad system understanding across electrics, software, and control systems
* Experience from system design and safety-critical development
* Experience working in cross-functional environments
* Strong communication and documentation skills

  


**Why Epiroc?**  



By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.  



To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:
* Global career opportunities
* Learning & Development programs
* Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
* Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Community involvement

  


**Location and Travel**  



This position is based in Örebro, Sweden.  


**Application and Contact Information**  



Submit your application as soon as possible through our online system. The last day to apply is August 30, 2026. We review applications continuously.  



Our recruitment process includes interviews, reference checks, and assessments. We conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening to ensure a safe working environment. Expect transparent communication and a fair evaluation of your skills and experience.  



For questions, contact:  



Hiring Manager Thomas Johansson: thomas.johansson@epiroc.com

Recruitment Specialist Zuzana Kalivodova: zuzana.kalivodova@epiroc.com  

**It all starts with people.** The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www.epiroc.com

title: Software Engineer, iOS
description:
**Join us in building a world-class creative platform used by millions of people.**
 Our product, SCRL, is a powerful photo and video editing platform loved by millions of creators worldwide.
   

  

 We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our iOS team and grow into the kind of engineer who can tackle the hardest problems in mobile.
   

  

**About The Role**
 SCRL isn't a typical app. It's a tool people use to create, which means the engineering challenges go far beyond standard iOS development: real-time image and video manipulation, complex multi-touch interactions, advanced layout systems, and performance-sensitive rendering.
   

  

 You'll be joining a team of experienced engineers who care deeply about their craft. You'll ship real features to millions of users, work on problems that stretch your abilities, and learn faster than you would almost anywhere else.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Build
   

  

* Develop features across SCRL's editing experience, from UI components to underlying logic.
* Work on gesture-driven interactions: touch handling, dragging, resizing, and snapping.
* Contribute to performance improvements where frame rates and responsiveness matter.
* Write clean, correct Swift that holds up as the product evolves.


 Learn & Grow
   

  

* Deepen your understanding of the iOS platform: UIKit, Core Animation, and frameworks like Core Image and AVFoundation.
* Build intuition for coordinate geometry, state management, and how complex editing features fit together.
* Get regular feedback through code reviews, pairing sessions, and direct collaboration with senior engineers.
* Take on increasingly complex problems as your skills and confidence grow.


 Collaborate
   

  

* Work closely with design to bring interactions, animations, and transitions to life.
* Participate in planning sessions and contribute ideas to how features are built.
* Share what you learn and help strengthen the team around you.


 You should have
   

  

* Solid experience in iOS development and Swift.
* Experience building interactive, gesture-driven interfaces.
* Familiarity with UIKit and Core Animation.
* Curiosity about what happens beneath the surface of the frameworks you use.
* A desire to get significantly better at what you do.


 Strong signals
   

  

* Experience working on consumer apps with a large user base.
* Interest in how tools and editors are built.
* A natural curiosity about what happens beneath the surface of the frameworks you use.
* Experience with animation, transitions, or motion in iOS apps.
* You've built something on your own time that you're proud of.


 What we offer
   

  

* The chance to work on genuinely hard, interesting problems every day.
* A product that millions of people use to create, not just another feed or dashboard.
* A team that will push you to grow and give you the support to do it.
* Real ownership and visible impact from day one.
* Great colleagues and office in central Stockholm.
* Competitive compensation and opportunities for professional development.


 We’re a growing team based in central Stockholm, working closely across disciplines to build products people love. We care deeply about craft, collaboration and creating a place where everyone can learn and grow.

title: Lead .NET & Azure Developer
description:
IT Corporate is a Nordic IT unit with close to 70 employees and consultants divided into four delivery units. We are responsible for systems and IT solutions for If's corporate units such as Accounting, Cash Management, Marketing, Legal and HR.
 



  





 To strengthen our support for ongoing business and tech transformation, we are seeking a Lead developer in our Accounting Domain team with extensive experience of .NET & Azure development, who is also a dedicated team player with a willingness to share knowledge and experience with colleagues.
 



  





 Join us as we build a modern, sustainable tech unit within IT Corporate. Our mission is to embed sustainability in all operations, delivering high-quality, stable solutions that empower businesses. We’re modernizing our tech ecosystem to support the CFO unit’s transformation and improve financial reporting and payment flows.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 We are looking for a talented Lead Developer (focus on .NET & Azure) who will play a leading role in delivering accounting solutions for all Nordic and Baltic countries. This position will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile way of working to streamline development processes, enhance system reliability, and ensure seamless integration of financial data and payment flows.
 



  





 You will act as Tech Lead for solutions supporting our finance processes, with a strong focus on data quality, scalability, and business value. You are responsible for;
 


* Drive technical direction aligned with architecture decisions within the Accounting domain
* Act as technical mentor and elevate team capabilities
* Ensure alignment with If architecture and standards
* Lead design reviews and guide solution quality



  





 Working in a data-driven environment built on Azure and Databricks, you will lead the development of systems for file ingestion, transformation, aggregation, and output generation, while also shaping engineering practices, development workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
 



  





**We offer** 



* Great insurance benefits
* High pension savings
* An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Lunch benefit



  





**About The Team** 




 IT Corporate offers the opportunity to work in a modern IT environment where maintenance and new development go hand in hand. Our technical landscape spans several platforms, and our applications support a wide range of business functions and processes. Within the team, you will work close to both business and IT stakeholders and combine deep technical work with collaboration across project management, requirements, testing, and operations. You will have the opportunity to contribute to both smaller improvements and larger transformation initiatives, while helping to build a modern finance landscape with trusted data flows across countries and functions.
 



  





**Who are you?** 




 You are a strong full-stack developer and technical leader who thrives in collaboration and knowledge sharing. You are recognized as proactive, reliable, and solution-oriented, with the ability to translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions. You communicate clearly, influence without formal authority, and build trust across engineering, operations, product, and business stakeholders. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, continuously learning, mentoring others, and driving high-quality outcomes.
 



  





**You also have:** 



* **Education** 
 : A degree in Computer Science, Systems Science, or another relevant field, or equivalent experience.
* **Development experience:** 
 Strong experience in C#, .NET, Blazor, React, and Azure Functions, combined with strong solution design capability across integrations, data flows, scalability, and resilient architecture. Strong SQL skills are essential, while experience with Databricks and Python is highly valued. Familiarity with legacy data and integration tools such as SSIS is a plus.
* **AI, DevOps & Automation:** 
 Experience with Azure DevOps and a strong drive to improve CI/CD, engineering workflows, and developer experience. Experience using AI tools to support development, automation, and engineering efficiency is also valued.
* **Cloud & Hosting:** 
 Solid understanding of Microsoft server environments and Azure services, with a preference for PaaS and serverless architectures, as well as a strong focus on operational excellence, observability, and secure-by-default principles.
* **Agile ways of working:** 
 Hands-on experience of agile development and close collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
* **End-to-End Delivery:** 
 Proven ability to manage the full software development lifecycle—from ideation and design to deployment, operations, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* **Industry knowledge:** 
 Experience from the insurance industry or a similarly complex and regulated environment is an advantage.

 Fluent in English and Swedish.

 By agreement.
